_note: CR-29 (OSA as the operator agent) is proposed, not in the contract: contract 1.1.0 doesn't exist yet. These are the routes, fields and events the prototype assumes, taken from the CR-29 doc, section 6. The OSA screens use them only while the osa flag is on. Remove this file's entries as they land in @avel/contract.
source: docs/CR-29 OSA as the operator agent.md, Nov 13, 2026
fields: PendingDecisionDto.brief: DecisionBriefDto | null  (ref, boundVersion, summary, evidence[], recommendation, confidence: high | medium | low, risk, reasonDraft, writtenAt, superseded)
StatusDto.terminal: { attached: boolean, lastSeenAt: IsoTime | null }

StatusDto.assistant: { session: active | paused | none, spendUsed: number, spendCap: number }  (assumed: CR-29 decision 4 leaves the cap open; no dollars on screen, so the web shows used over cap as a percent)
AssistantTaskDto: { id, subject: { kind, ref, label }, request, state: queued | working | done | failed, result: string | null, links: string[], createdAt, updatedAt }
OperatorFocusDto: { ref: string | null, label: string | null, setBy: operator | assistant | cli, at }
procedureNames: The procedure names (assistant.*, operator.setFocus, operator.getFocus) are the prototype's guesses; CR-29 gives only method and path.
